Desktop OS.reason_zh: SMB Server 的身份验证实现缺陷可导致基于网络的权限提升，破坏安全文件共享及系统间通信。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NTFS permits unauthorized local code execution, threatening filesystem integrity and user-space isolation.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NTFS permits unauthorized local code execution, threatening filesystem integrity and user-space isolation.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未经授权的本地代码执行，威胁文件系统完整性与用户态隔离。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows network-based privilege escalation, directly targeting active RDP sessions and client endpoints.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap overflow in the Remote Desktop Client allows network-based privilege escalation, directly targeting active RDP sessions and client endpoints.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的堆溢出漏洞可导致基于网络的权限提升，直接针对活跃的 RDP 会话及客户端终端。

Desktop OS.reason: Race condition in Windows Runtime enables network-based privilege escalation, highlighting instability in core Windows application frameworks.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Race condition in Windows Runtime enables network-based privilege escalation, highlighting instability in core Windows application frameworks.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Runtime 中的竞态条件可导致基于网络的提权，凸显了核心 Windows 应用框架的不稳定性。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free in Windows Runtime allows network-based privilege escalation, increasing attack surface for modern Windows APIs.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free in Windows Runtime allows network-based privilege escalation, increasing attack surface for modern Windows APIs.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows Runtime 中的释放后使用漏洞可允许基于网络的提权，扩大了现代 Windows API 的攻击面。

Desktop OS.reason: Out-of-bounds read in Windows NTFS allows unauthorized local code execution, risking data confidentiality and system stability.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Out-of-bounds read in Windows NTFS allows unauthorized local code execution, risking data confidentiality and system stability.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 中的越界读取漏洞可允许未经授权的本地代码执行，威胁数据机密性与系统稳定性。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NTFS enables unauthorized local code execution, requiring immediate patching to maintain filesystem reliability.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Windows NTFS enables unauthorized local code execution, requiring immediate patching to maintain filesystem reliability.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows NTFS 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可导致未经授权的本地代码执行，需立即发布补丁以保障文件系统可靠性。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical kernel-level use-after-free flaw enabling unauthorized local privilege escalation. Its high CVSS score and core component impact make it a prime target for post-exploitation lateral movement.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical kernel-level use-after-free flaw enabling unauthorized local privilege escalation. Its high CVSS score and core component impact make it a prime target for post-exploitation lateral movement.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 关键的内核级释放后使用漏洞可导致未经授权的本地提权。其高 CVSS 评分及对核心组件的影响使其成为利用后横向移动的首要目标。

Desktop OS.reason: Race condition in the Print Spooler allows network-based code execution. Given the ubiquity of print services in enterprise environments, this poses a severe remote exploitation risk.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Race condition in the Print Spooler allows network-based code execution. Given the ubiquity of print services in enterprise environments, this poses a severe remote exploitation risk.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Print Spooler 中的竞态条件可导致基于网络的代码执行。鉴于打印服务在企业环境中的广泛部署，该漏洞构成严重的远程利用风险。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in GDI+ permits unauthorized local code execution. As a foundational graphics subsystem, exploitation could lead to full system compromise without user interaction.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in GDI+ permits unauthorized local code execution. As a foundational graphics subsystem, exploitation could lead to full system compromise without user interaction.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GDI+ 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可允许未经授权的本地代码执行。作为底层图形子系统，利用该漏洞无需用户交互即可导致系统被完全控制。

Desktop OS.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. This critical flaw directly compromises enterprise remote access infrastructure and endpoint security.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Remote Desktop Client enables unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. This critical flaw directly compromises enterprise remote access infrastructure and endpoint security.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Remote Desktop Client 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可实现网络层面的未认证远程代码执行。该关键漏洞直接危及企业远程访问基础设施与终端安全。

Desktop OS.reason: A race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows adjacent network attackers to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation could lead to full system compromise across local network segments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A race condition in the Windows TCP/IP stack allows adjacent network attackers to execute arbitrary code. Exploitation could lead to full system compromise across local network segments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Windows TCP/IP 协议栈中的竞态条件可使相邻网络攻击者执行任意代码。利用该漏洞可能导致同一局域网段内的系统被完全控制。

Desktop OS.reason: Use-after-free vulnerability in Win32K permits local privilege escalation to kernel-level access. Attackers can leverage this to bypass security boundaries on compromised workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Use-after-free vulnerability in Win32K permits local privilege escalation to kernel-level access. Attackers can leverage this to bypass security boundaries on compromised workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Win32K 中的释放后使用漏洞可允许本地提权至内核级访问。攻击者可利用此漏洞绕过已沦陷工作站的权限边界。

Desktop OS.reason: Improper input validation in Microsoft Surface firmware/drivers allows remote code execution. Given its extreme severity, immediate patching is required to maintain hardware and OS integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Improper input validation in Microsoft Surface firmware/drivers allows remote code execution. Given its extreme severity, immediate patching is required to maintain hardware and OS integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Microsoft Surface 固件/驱动程序中的输入验证缺陷可导致远程代码执行。鉴于其极高严重性，必须立即发布补丁以保障硬件与操作系统完整性。

Desktop OS.reason: A race condition in the Linux kernel's af_unix component enables local privilege escalation, directly impacting all Linux-based desktop environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A race condition in the Linux kernel's af_unix component enables local privilege escalation, directly impacting all Linux-based desktop environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Linux 内核 af_unix 组件中的竞态条件可导致本地提权，直接影响所有基于 Linux 的桌面环境。

Desktop OS.reason: FreeRDP's protocol negotiation bypass allows unauthenticated attackers to force RDSTLS connections, effectively circumventing server-side security policies.
Desktop OS.reason_en: FreeRDP's protocol negotiation bypass allows unauthenticated attackers to force RDSTLS connections, effectively circumventing server-side security policies.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: FreeRDP 的协议协商绕过漏洞允许未授权攻击者强制建立 RDSTLS 连接，从而有效规避服务端安全策略。

Desktop OS.reason: Avast sandbox minifilter driver flaw allows low-privileged attackers to escape file isolation and escalate to SYSTEM.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Avast sandbox minifilter driver flaw allows low-privileged attackers to escape file isolation and escalate to SYSTEM.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Avast 沙箱微型过滤驱动程序的缺陷允许低权限攻击者突破文件隔离限制并提权至 SYSTEM 账户。

Desktop OS.reason: Missing authorization on the MCP kernel endpoint exposes 31 tools including unrestricted file operations, enabling complete system compromise.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Missing authorization on the MCP kernel endpoint exposes 31 tools including unrestricted file operations, enabling complete system compromise.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: MCP 内核端点缺失权限校验，暴露了包含无限制文件操作在内的 31 项功能，可导致系统被完全控制。

Desktop OS.reason: Reflected XSS in the bazaar plugin readme handler executes arbitrary code via crafted deep links with full browser context.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Reflected XSS in the bazaar plugin readme handler executes arbitrary code via crafted deep links with full browser context.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: bazaar 插件 readme 处理程序中的反射型 XSS 漏洞可通过构造的深度链接在完整浏览器上下文中执行任意代码。

Desktop OS.reason: Missing maximum size limit on RTP depayload buffers enables remote denial of service via continuous fragmented stream flooding.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Missing maximum size limit on RTP depayload buffers enables remote denial of service via continuous fragmented stream flooding.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: RTP 解包缓冲区缺乏最大长度限制，攻击者可通过持续发送分片流洪水实现远程拒绝服务(DoS)。

Desktop OS.reason: Integer overflow in GIMP's PSD plugin triggers a heap corruption during thumbnail generation, posing a direct risk to desktop media workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Integer overflow in GIMP's PSD plugin triggers a heap corruption during thumbnail generation, posing a direct risk to desktop media workflows.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: GIMP 的 PSD 插件中的整数溢出会在缩略图生成时触发堆损坏，直接威胁桌面媒体工作流的安全。

Desktop OS.reason: Path traversal flaws in MidnightBSD's package manager allow malicious bundles to write files outside intended directories, compromising system integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Path traversal flaws in MidnightBSD's package manager allow malicious bundles to write files outside intended directories, compromising system integrity.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: MidnightBSD 软件包管理器中的路径遍历漏洞允许恶意软件包向非预期目录写入文件，从而破坏系统完整性。

Desktop OS.reason: Unescaped HTML in bookmark labels enables stored XSS in SiYuan's Electron renderer, granting attackers child_process access for potential RCE.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Unescaped HTML in bookmark labels enables stored XSS in SiYuan's Electron renderer, granting attackers child_process access for potential RCE.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 书签标签中的未转义 HTML 可在 SiYuan 的 Electron 渲染器中引发存储型 XSS，使攻击者获得 child_process 接口访问权限，进而可能导致远程代码执行(RCE)。

Desktop OS.reason: Privilege escalation in VirtualBox core components allows local users to compromise host environments running virtual machines.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Privilege escalation in VirtualBox core components allows local users to compromise host environments running virtual machines.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: VirtualBox 核心组件中的提权漏洞允许本地用户攻破运行虚拟机的宿主机环境。

Desktop OS.reason: Out-of-bounds write in the EA SCHl audio parser enables potential code execution when processing malicious media files locally.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Out-of-bounds write in the EA SCHl audio parser enables potential code execution when processing malicious media files locally.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: EA SCHl 音频解析器中的越界写入漏洞在处理本地恶意媒体文件时可能触发代码执行。

Desktop OS.reason: A maliciously crafted MODEL file parsed by Autodesk desktop applications triggers an out-of-bounds write, enabling potential arbitrary code execution or data corruption.
Desktop OS.reason_en: A maliciously crafted MODEL file parsed by Autodesk desktop applications triggers an out-of-bounds write, enabling potential arbitrary code execution or data corruption.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Autodesk 桌面应用程序解析的恶意构造 MODEL 文件会触发越界写入，可能导致任意代码执行或数据损坏。

Desktop OS.reason: Autodesk PDF parsing contains a use-after-free flaw that attackers can exploit to crash the application, disclose sensitive memory contents, or execute arbitrary code locally.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Autodesk PDF parsing contains a use-after-free flaw that attackers can exploit to crash the application, disclose sensitive memory contents, or execute arbitrary code locally.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Autodesk PDF 解析模块存在释放后使用漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞导致应用程序崩溃、泄露敏感内存数据或在本地执行任意代码。

Desktop OS.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in Affinity document parsing allows arbitrary code execution upon opening crafted files, posing a direct threat to end-user workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in Affinity document parsing allows arbitrary code execution upon opening crafted files, posing a direct threat to end-user workstations.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Affinity 文档解析过程中的栈缓冲区溢出漏洞在打开恶意构造的文件时可执行任意代码，直接威胁终端用户工作站。

Desktop OS.reason: DLL hijacking via unsafe search paths enables local attackers to execute malicious libraries, potentially leading to privilege escalation on affected Windows systems.
Desktop OS.reason_en: DLL hijacking via unsafe search paths enables local attackers to execute malicious libraries, potentially leading to privilege escalation on affected Windows systems.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 利用不安全的搜索路径实现的 DLL 劫持漏洞允许本地攻击者加载恶意动态链接库，可能导致受影响 Windows 系统的权限提升。

Desktop OS.reason: Easily exploitable local vulnerability in Oracle VM VirtualBox allows attackers to compromise the host system, posing a direct threat to desktop virtualization environments.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Easily exploitable local vulnerability in Oracle VM VirtualBox allows attackers to compromise the host system, posing a direct threat to desktop virtualization environments.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: Oracle VM VirtualBox 中存在易于利用的本地漏洞，攻击者可借此攻破宿主机系统，直接威胁桌面虚拟化环境。

Desktop OS.reason: Multiple externally reported flaws in HP printer drivers could enable remote code execution or privilege escalation, impacting end-user workstations and peripheral security.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Multiple externally reported flaws in HP printer drivers could enable remote code execution or privilege escalation, impacting end-user workstations and peripheral security.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: HP 打印机驱动程序中存在多项外部披露的漏洞，可能导致远程代码执行或权限提升，严重影响终端用户工作站及外设安全。

Desktop OS.reason: Critical combination of hardcoded credentials and SSRF in ASUS Control Center enables unauthorized SSH access and full local system compromise.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Critical combination of hardcoded credentials and SSRF in ASUS Control Center enables unauthorized SSH access and full local system compromise.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: ASUS Control Center 中硬编码凭据与 SSRF 漏洞的组合可导致未授权 SSH 访问及完整的本地系统沦陷。

Desktop OS.reason: Allows local administrators to read and write arbitrary physical memory via IOCTL requests, effectively bypassing OS-enforced memory protection mechanisms.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Allows local administrators to read and write arbitrary physical memory via IOCTL requests, effectively bypassing OS-enforced memory protection mechanisms.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 该漏洞允许本地管理员通过 IOCTL 请求读写任意物理内存，实质上绕过了操作系统强制执行的内存保护机制。

Desktop OS.reason: Enables arbitrary code execution with SYSTEM privileges through tampered IPC messages in ASUS Business Manager, posing a severe local privilege escalation risk.
Desktop OS.reason_en: Enables arbitrary code execution with SYSTEM privileges through tampered IPC messages in ASUS Business Manager, posing a severe local privilege escalation risk.
Desktop OS.reason_zh: 通过篡改ASUS Business Manager中的IPC消息，可实现以SYSTEM权限执行任意代码，构成严重的本地提权风险。

Mobile Security.reason: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, compromising mobile productivity workflows.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS allows unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, compromising mobile productivity workflows.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Microsoft 365 Copilot for iOS 中存在访问控制不当问题，允许通过网络进行未授权提权，危及移动生产力工作流。

Mobile Security.reason: External file path control in Microsoft Edge for Android enables information disclosure over the network, exposing sensitive mobile browsing data.
Mobile Security.reason_en: External file path control in Microsoft Edge for Android enables information disclosure over the network, exposing sensitive mobile browsing data.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge for Android 中存在外部文件路径控制问题，可导致网络信息泄露，暴露敏感的移动浏览数据。

Mobile Security.reason: ToCTOU race condition in Edge for Android permits remote code execution through maliciously timed network requests.
Mobile Security.reason_en: ToCTOU race condition in Edge for Android permits remote code execution through maliciously timed network requests.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Edge for Android 中存在时间检查与使用竞争条件（ToCTOU），可通过恶意构造时间的网络请求实现远程代码执行。

Mobile Security.reason: Improper UI layer restrictions in the Bing iOS app enable network-based spoofing attacks. This undermines user trust and could facilitate credential harvesting or malicious redirects.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Improper UI layer restrictions in the Bing iOS app enable network-based spoofing attacks. This undermines user trust and could facilitate credential harvesting or malicious redirects.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Bing iOS 应用中存在UI层限制不当问题，可支持基于网络的欺骗攻击。此举会破坏用户信任，并可能助长凭证窃取或恶意重定向。

Mobile Security.reason: External path control in Edge for Android allows local information disclosure. Attackers could potentially access sensitive cached data or configuration files on compromised devices.
Mobile Security.reason_en: External path control in Edge for Android allows local information disclosure. Attackers could potentially access sensitive cached data or configuration files on compromised devices.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Edge for Android 中存在外部路径控制问题，可导致本地信息泄露。攻击者可能访问受损设备上的敏感缓存数据或配置文件。

Mobile Security.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Bluetooth Port Driver enables adjacent network code execution. This directly threatens mobile devices connecting via Bluetooth, risking malware installation or data exfiltration.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows Bluetooth Port Driver enables adjacent network code execution. This directly threatens mobile devices connecting via Bluetooth, risking malware installation or data exfiltration.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: Windows Bluetooth Port Driver 中存在基于堆的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可实现相邻网络代码执行。这直接威胁通过蓝牙连接的设备，可能导致恶意软件安装或数据外泄。

Mobile Security.reason: Cross-domain SSO account takeover vulnerability allows merging victim accounts based on email without validating provider domain authorization.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Cross-domain SSO account takeover vulnerability allows merging victim accounts based on email without validating provider domain authorization.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 跨域单点登录（SSO）账户接管漏洞允许在未验证提供商域授权的情况下，基于电子邮件合并受害者账户。

Mobile Security.reason: Memory corruption from copying unverified external data exceeds allocated buffers, posing a critical exploitation risk on Snapdragon mobile SoCs.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Memory corruption from copying unverified external data exceeds allocated buffers, posing a critical exploitation risk on Snapdragon mobile SoCs.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 复制未经验证的外部数据导致内存损坏且超出已分配缓冲区，在 Snapdragon 移动SoC上构成关键利用风险。

Mobile Security.reason: Processing unverified neighbor system data triggers out-of-bounds memory access, potentially compromising mobile device stability and security.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Processing unverified neighbor system data triggers out-of-bounds memory access, potentially compromising mobile device stability and security.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 处理未经验证的邻居系统数据会触发越界内存访问，可能危及移动设备的稳定性与安全性。

Mobile Security.reason: Memory corruption during external buffer validation using flawed addition checks poses a significant integrity and exploitation risk to Qualcomm Snapdragon mobile SoCs.
Mobile Security.reason_en: Memory corruption during external buffer validation using flawed addition checks poses a significant integrity and exploitation risk to Qualcomm Snapdragon mobile SoCs.
Mobile Security.reason_zh: 在使用有缺陷的加法检查进行外部缓冲区验证时发生内存损坏，对 Qualcomm Snapdragon 移动SoC构成重大的完整性与利用风险。

IoT Security.reason: Stack buffer overflow in Hamlib's unauthenticated rigctld service allows remote code execution on connected radio equipment. Compromised IoT radios could be repurposed for network pivoting or physical disruption.
IoT Security.reason_en: Stack buffer overflow in Hamlib's unauthenticated rigctld service allows remote code execution on connected radio equipment. Compromised IoT radios could be repurposed for network pivoting or physical disruption.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Hamlib 的未认证 rigctld 服务中存在栈缓冲区溢出漏洞，可在连接的无线电设备上实现远程代码执行。受损的IoT无线电设备可能被重新用于网络跳板或物理干扰。

IoT Security.reason: Improper TLS certificate validation in the AWS IoT SDK enables MITM attacks against connected devices, risking telemetry interception and command injection.
IoT Security.reason_en: Improper TLS certificate validation in the AWS IoT SDK enables MITM attacks against connected devices, risking telemetry interception and command injection.
IoT Security.reason_zh: AWS IoT SDK 中存在TLS证书验证不当问题，可对连接设备实施中间人（MITM）攻击，面临遥测数据拦截和命令注入风险。

IoT Security.reason: Traccar GPS tracking platform suffers from a permission bypass that allows unauthorized deletion of tracking objects, disrupting fleet management operations.
IoT Security.reason_en: Traccar GPS tracking platform suffers from a permission bypass that allows unauthorized deletion of tracking objects, disrupting fleet management operations.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Traccar GPS 跟踪平台存在权限绕过漏洞，允许未经授权删除跟踪对象，扰乱车队管理运营。

IoT Security.reason: Multipart parser boundary overflow on ESP32/ESP8266 devices allows remote denial of service or potential code execution.
IoT Security.reason_en: Multipart parser boundary overflow on ESP32/ESP8266 devices allows remote denial of service or potential code execution.
IoT Security.reason_zh: ESP32/ESP8266 设备上的多部分解析器边界溢出漏洞可导致远程拒绝服务或潜在代码执行。

IoT Security.reason: Command injection in Netcore router firmware's tcpdump launch paths allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
IoT Security.reason_en: Command injection in Netcore router firmware's tcpdump launch paths allows unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Netcore 路由器固件的 tcpdump 启动路径中存在命令注入漏洞，允许未认证攻击者执行任意系统命令。

IoT Security.reason: Acceptance of client-controlled authentication cookies without server-side validation enables full account takeover in motionEye surveillance interfaces.
IoT Security.reason_en: Acceptance of client-controlled authentication cookies without server-side validation enables full account takeover in motionEye surveillance interfaces.
IoT Security.reason_zh: motionEye 监控界面在未进行服务端验证的情况下接受客户端控制的认证Cookie，可导致完整的账户接管。

IoT Security.reason: Fail-open authentication logic in Bambuddy allows attackers to exhaust resources and bypass login controls, compromising 3D printer management systems.
IoT Security.reason_en: Fail-open authentication logic in Bambuddy allows attackers to exhaust resources and bypass login controls, compromising 3D printer management systems.
IoT Security.reason_zh: Bambuddy 的故障开放（Fail-open）认证逻辑允许攻击者耗尽资源并绕过登录控制，危及3D打印机管理系统。

IoT Security.reason: Concurrent IOCTL requests to device control handlers cause race conditions that can destabilize industrial IoT gateways and edge controllers.
IoT Security.reason_en: Concurrent IOCTL requests to device control handlers cause race conditions that can destabilize industrial IoT gateways and edge controllers.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 向设备控制处理器并发发送IOCTL请求会导致竞争条件，可能使工业物联网网关和边缘控制器失稳。

IoT Security.reason: Buffer overflow in escape handling flows with insufficient user buffer sizes can crash or corrupt firmware in connected IoT devices.
IoT Security.reason_en: Buffer overflow in escape handling flows with insufficient user buffer sizes can crash or corrupt firmware in connected IoT devices.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 转义处理流程中因用户缓冲区大小不足导致的缓冲区溢出，可使连接的IoT设备固件崩溃或损坏。

IoT Security.reason: Buffer overflow during data copy operations with large offsets threatens the stability and security of embedded systems utilizing Snapdragon Industrial IoT platforms.
IoT Security.reason_en: Buffer overflow during data copy operations with large offsets threatens the stability and security of embedded systems utilizing Snapdragon Industrial IoT platforms.
IoT Security.reason_zh: 具有大偏移量的数据复制操作期间发生的缓冲区溢出，威胁使用 Snapdragon 工业物联网平台的嵌入式系统的稳定性与安全性。

Cloud Security.reason: Authorization bypass in Azure Active Directory B2C allows unauthenticated users to elevate privileges, directly compromising enterprise identity management and tenant-level security controls.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Authorization bypass in Azure Active Directory B2C allows unauthenticated users to elevate privileges, directly compromising enterprise identity management and tenant-level security controls.
Cloud Security.reason_zh: Azure Active Directory B2C 中存在授权绕过漏洞，允许未认证用户提升权限，直接危及企业身份管理和租户级安全控制。

Cloud Security.reason: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language permits unauthenticated privilege escalation, exposing critical cloud AI services to unauthorized administrative actions and data manipulation.
Cloud Security.reason_en: Missing authentication in Azure AI Language permits unauthenticated privilege escalation, exposing critical cloud AI services to unauthorized administrative actions and data manipulation.

Network Devices.reason_zh: 通过捕获重放攻击实现的Kerberos身份验证绕过支持基于网络的代码执行，从根本上破坏企业身份与访问管理体系。

Network Devices.reason: Stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server service allows remote code execution on adjacent networks, threatening critical network configuration services.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack-based buffer overflow in the DHCP Server service allows remote code execution on adjacent networks, threatening critical network configuration services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DHCP服务器服务中的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞允许在相邻网络中进行远程代码执行，威胁关键网络配置服务。

Network Devices.reason: Race condition in the DNS Server allows unauthorized network-based code execution, threatening core name resolution infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Race condition in the DNS Server allows unauthorized network-based code execution, threatening core name resolution infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS服务器中的竞态条件漏洞可导致未授权的网络代码执行，威胁核心名称解析基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Windows DHCP Server enables network-based denial of service, disrupting IP address allocation.
Network Devices.reason_en: Uncontrolled resource consumption in Windows DHCP Server enables network-based denial of service, disrupting IP address allocation.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP服务器中的资源消耗失控漏洞可导致基于网络的拒绝服务，中断IP地址分配。

Network Devices.reason: Origin validation error in Windows NAT allows network spoofing over adjacent segments, weakening network segmentation and trust boundaries.
Network Devices.reason_en: Origin validation error in Windows NAT allows network spoofing over adjacent segments, weakening network segmentation and trust boundaries.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows NAT中的源验证错误漏洞允许跨相邻网段进行网络欺骗，削弱网络分段与信任边界。

Network Devices.reason: Windows DHCP Server heap overflow permits unauthenticated network-based remote code execution, severely impacting core network infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Windows DHCP Server heap overflow permits unauthenticated network-based remote code execution, severely impacting core network infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP服务器堆溢出漏洞允许未认证的网络远程代码执行，严重影响核心网络基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Windows DNS use-after-free vulnerability allows network-based privilege escalation by corrupting name resolution processes.
Network Devices.reason_en: Windows DNS use-after-free vulnerability allows network-based privilege escalation by corrupting name resolution processes.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DNS释放后使用漏洞可通过破坏名称解析进程实现基于网络的权限提升。

Network Devices.reason: Remote Access Connection Manager use-after-free enables network-based privilege escalation through flawed connection handling routines.
Network Devices.reason_en: Remote Access Connection Manager use-after-free enables network-based privilege escalation through flawed connection handling routines.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 远程访问连接管理器的释放后使用漏洞可通过有缺陷的连接处理例程实现基于网络的权限提升。

Network Devices.reason: Windows Netlogon use-after-free allows network-based privilege escalation by exploiting domain controller authentication mechanisms.
Network Devices.reason_en: Windows Netlogon use-after-free allows network-based privilege escalation by exploiting domain controller authentication mechanisms.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows Netlogon释放后使用漏洞可通过利用域控制器身份验证机制实现基于网络的权限提升。

Network Devices.reason: Windows DHCP Client use-after-free enables local privilege escalation via network configuration processing flaws.
Network Devices.reason_en: Windows DHCP Client use-after-free enables local privilege escalation via network configuration processing flaws.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Client 中的释放后使用漏洞可通过网络配置处理缺陷实现本地权限提升。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows adjacent network code execution, potentially disrupting IP address management and network connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows DHCP Server allows adjacent network code execution, potentially disrupting IP address management and network connectivity.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DHCP Server 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致相邻网络代码执行，可能破坏 IP 地址管理与网络连接。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free in the Message Queuing Queue Manager enables unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising inter-process messaging infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free in the Message Queuing Queue Manager enables unauthenticated remote code execution, compromising inter-process messaging infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Message Queuing Queue Manager 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现未认证远程代码执行，破坏进程间消息传递基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Improper authentication in the Windows RPC API allows adjacent network privilege escalation, weakening core distributed computing protocols.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper authentication in the Windows RPC API allows adjacent network privilege escalation, weakening core distributed computing protocols.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows RPC API 中的身份验证不当可导致相邻网络权限提升，削弱核心分布式计算协议的安全性。

Network Devices.reason: Improper access control in Windows DNS allows authorized local tampering, risking domain resolution integrity and cache poisoning attacks.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper access control in Windows DNS allows authorized local tampering, risking domain resolution integrity and cache poisoning attacks.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows DNS 中的访问控制不当允许已授权本地篡改，危及域名解析完整性并可能导致缓存投毒攻击。

Network Devices.reason: Missing authentication in RRAS allows local privilege escalation, exposing routing and remote access configurations to insider threats.
Network Devices.reason_en: Missing authentication in RRAS allows local privilege escalation, exposing routing and remote access configurations to insider threats.
Network Devices.reason_zh: RRAS 中缺失身份验证可导致本地权限提升，使路由与远程访问配置暴露于内部威胁之下。

Network Devices.reason: Insufficient access control granularity in the Windows Filtering Platform allows local privilege escalation, undermining firewall and traffic filtering rules.
Network Devices.reason_en: Insufficient access control granularity in the Windows Filtering Platform allows local privilege escalation, undermining firewall and traffic filtering rules.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows Filtering Platform 中访问控制粒度不足可导致本地权限提升，破坏防火墙与流量过滤规则。

Network Devices.reason: Improper authorization in RPC Runtime allows local privilege escalation, affecting remote procedure call security boundaries and inter-service communication.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper authorization in RPC Runtime allows local privilege escalation, affecting remote procedure call security boundaries and inter-service communication.
Network Devices.reason_zh: RPC Runtime 中的授权不当可导致本地权限提升，影响远程过程调用安全边界与服务间通信。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows FTP Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. Unpatched FTP servers remain highly susceptible to automated exploitation campaigns.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the Windows FTP Service allows unauthenticated remote code execution over the network. Unpatched FTP servers remain highly susceptible to automated exploitation campaigns.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Windows FTP Service 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致通过网络进行的未认证远程代码执行。未打补丁的 FTP 服务器仍极易受到自动化利用攻击的影响。

Network Devices.reason: Use-after-free flaw in DNS Server enables remote code execution over the network. Compromising DNS infrastructure facilitates widespread traffic interception and phishing operations.
Network Devices.reason_en: Use-after-free flaw in DNS Server enables remote code execution over the network. Compromising DNS infrastructure facilitates widespread traffic interception and phishing operations.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DNS Server 中的释放后使用漏洞可实现网络远程代码执行。入侵 DNS 基础设施将助长大规模流量拦截与钓鱼活动。

Network Devices.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in the IKE Protocol allows remote denial of service. This disrupts VPN connectivity and undermines network segmentation controls.
Network Devices.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in the IKE Protocol allows remote denial of service. This disrupts VPN connectivity and undermines network segmentation controls.
Network Devices.reason_zh: IKE Protocol 中的基于堆的缓冲区溢出可导致远程拒绝服务。这将中断 VPN 连接并削弱网络分段控制机制。

Network Devices.reason: NetBox Device Type Library deserializes untrusted pickle files during test execution, posing a severe RCE risk for network inventory and documentation systems.
Network Devices.reason_en: NetBox Device Type Library deserializes untrusted pickle files during test execution, posing a severe RCE risk for network inventory and documentation systems.
Network Devices.reason_zh: NetBox Device Type Library 在测试执行期间反序列化不受信任的 pickle 文件，为网络资产清单与文档系统带来严重的远程代码执行（RCE）风险。

Network Devices.reason: MikroTik RouterOS SMB daemon heap corruption allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malformed SessionSetupAndX requests targeting legacy SMB1.
Network Devices.reason_en: MikroTik RouterOS SMB daemon heap corruption allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via malformed SessionSetupAndX requests targeting legacy SMB1.
Network Devices.reason_zh: MikroTik RouterOS SMB 守护进程的堆损坏漏洞允许远程攻击者通过针对旧版 SMB1 的畸形 SessionSetupAndX 请求执行任意代码。

Network Devices.reason: CPU exhaustion via SVCB/HTTPS AliasMode records significantly impacts DNS resolver availability and recursive lookup performance.
Network Devices.reason_en: CPU exhaustion via SVCB/HTTPS AliasMode records significantly impacts DNS resolver availability and recursive lookup performance.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 通过 SVCB/HTTPS AliasMode 记录耗尽 CPU 资源会显著影响 DNS 解析器的可用性与递归查询性能。

Network Devices.reason: Crafted DoH request with invalid SIG(0) causes named abort, disrupting DNS resolution services.
Network Devices.reason_en: Crafted DoH request with invalid SIG(0) causes named abort, disrupting DNS resolution services.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 包含无效 SIG(0) 的构造性 DoH 请求会导致 named 进程中止，从而中断 DNS 解析服务。

Network Devices.reason: Misconfigured password script with %u substitution allows remote command injection via unsanitized usernames.
Network Devices.reason_en: Misconfigured password script with %u substitution allows remote command injection via unsanitized usernames.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 配置错误的密码脚本若使用 %u 替换，会通过未过滤的用户名导致远程命令注入。

Network Devices.reason: Insufficient input validation in management workflows allows interpreted configuration values to execute operating-system commands.
Network Devices.reason_en: Insufficient input validation in management workflows allows interpreted configuration values to execute operating-system commands.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 管理工作流中输入验证不足会导致解释型配置值被执行操作系统命令。

Network Devices.reason: Incorrect permissions in Cisco Secure FMC's sftunnel protocol allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root on management appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: Incorrect permissions in Cisco Secure FMC's sftunnel protocol allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands as root on management appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Cisco Secure FMC 的 sftunnel 协议中存在权限配置错误，允许已认证攻击者在管理设备上以 root 权限执行任意命令。

Network Devices.reason: Insecure deserialization of untrusted data over sftunnel management connections grants root privileges to authenticated attackers targeting Cisco FMC.
Network Devices.reason_en: Insecure deserialization of untrusted data over sftunnel management connections grants root privileges to authenticated attackers targeting Cisco FMC.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 通过 sftunnel 管理连接对不受信任数据进行不安全的反序列化，可为针对 Cisco FMC 的已认证攻击者授予 root 权限。

Network Devices.reason: Multiple flaws in HP Advance server software enable privilege escalation and remote code execution, impacting managed print and hardware infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Multiple flaws in HP Advance server software enable privilege escalation and remote code execution, impacting managed print and hardware infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: HP Advance 服务器软件中的多项缺陷可导致权限提升与远程代码执行，影响受管打印与硬件基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution as root on Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center severely disrupts enterprise network security operations.
Network Devices.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution as root on Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center severely disrupts enterprise network security operations.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 在 Cisco Secure Firewall Management Center 上以 root 权限进行未认证远程代码执行，将严重破坏企业网络安全运营。

Network Devices.reason: Insecure deserialization in the External Database Access feature grants full root-level command execution on Cisco ASA/FTD appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: Insecure deserialization in the External Database Access feature grants full root-level command execution on Cisco ASA/FTD appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: External Database Access 功能中的不安全反序列化可在 Cisco ASA/FTD 设备上授予完整的 root 级命令执行权限。

Network Devices.reason: DTLS message handling flaws enable remote denial-of-service attacks against Cisco firewall hardware, impacting network availability.
Network Devices.reason_en: DTLS message handling flaws enable remote denial-of-service attacks against Cisco firewall hardware, impacting network availability.
Network Devices.reason_zh: DTLS 消息处理缺陷可引发针对 Cisco 防火墙硬件的远程拒绝服务攻击，影响网络可用性。

Network Devices.reason: Improper SSO token management in Cisco ASDM allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions on security management appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: Improper SSO token management in Cisco ASDM allows unauthenticated remote attackers to hijack administrator sessions on security management appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Cisco ASDM 中 SSO 令牌管理不当，允许未认证远程攻击者劫持安全设备上的管理员会话。

Network Devices.reason: Critical flaws identified in Cisco Nexus Dashboard software could enable complete system compromise or denial of service, impacting core network orchestration capabilities.
Network Devices.reason_en: Critical flaws identified in Cisco Nexus Dashboard software could enable complete system compromise or denial of service, impacting core network orchestration capabilities.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 在 Cisco Nexus Dashboard 软件中发现的关键缺陷可能导致系统完全沦陷或拒绝服务，影响核心网络编排能力。

Network Devices.reason: Unauthenticated REST API exposure on Cisco ISE lacks proper authorization checks, allowing complete administrative takeover of critical identity management infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Unauthenticated REST API exposure on Cisco ISE lacks proper authorization checks, allowing complete administrative takeover of critical identity management infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Cisco ISE 上未认证的 REST API 暴露缺乏适当的授权检查，允许攻击者完全接管关键的身份管理基础设施。

Network Devices.reason: Unauthenticated gNPSI client requests can trigger arbitrary code execution on Arista EOS switches, granting full administrative control over network switching fabric.
Network Devices.reason_en: Unauthenticated gNPSI client requests can trigger arbitrary code execution on Arista EOS switches, granting full administrative control over network switching fabric.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 未认证的 gNPSI 客户端请求可在 Arista EOS 交换机上触发任意代码执行，从而获得对网络交换架构的完全管理控制权。

Network Devices.reason: Stack overflow during the unauthenticated login process on Checkpoint gateways enables remote root code execution, severely compromising perimeter security appliances.
Network Devices.reason_en: Stack overflow during the unauthenticated login process on Checkpoint gateways enables remote root code execution, severely compromising perimeter security appliances.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Checkpoint 网关在未认证登录过程中存在栈溢出漏洞，可导致远程 root 代码执行，严重破坏边界安全设备。

Network Devices.reason: Actively exploited unauthenticated API flaw bypasses authentication controls on Cisco ISE, granting attackers full administrative access to network policy infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_en: Actively exploited unauthenticated API flaw bypasses authentication controls on Cisco ISE, granting attackers full administrative access to network policy infrastructure.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 正在被主动利用的未认证 API 缺陷绕过了 Cisco ISE 的身份验证控制，使攻击者能够完全访问网络策略基础设施的管理权限。

Network Devices.reason: Authenticated REST API command injection on Cisco ISE allows privilege escalation to root, compromising the underlying operating system and network security controls.
Network Devices.reason_en: Authenticated REST API command injection on Cisco ISE allows privilege escalation to root, compromising the underlying operating system and network security controls.
Network Devices.reason_zh: Cisco ISE 中已认证的 REST API 命令注入可导致权限提升至 root，破坏底层操作系统与网络安全控制机制。

Network Devices.reason: Authenticated gNMI client can execute arbitrary code with root privileges on Arista switches, severely impacting network infrastructure stability and security.
Network Devices.reason_en: Authenticated gNMI client can execute arbitrary code with root privileges on Arista switches, severely impacting network infrastructure stability and security.
Network Devices.reason_zh: 经过身份验证的gNMI客户端可在Arista交换机上以root权限执行任意代码，严重威胁网络基础设施的稳定性和安全性。

Industrial Control.reason: Improper message integrity enforcement in Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC controllers allows attackers to tamper with industrial communications, risking operational disruption, safety hazards, and production downtime.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Improper message integrity enforcement in Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC controllers allows attackers to tamper with industrial communications, risking operational disruption, safety hazards, and production downtime.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 三菱电机MELSEC控制器的消息完整性保护机制存在缺陷，攻击者可借此篡改工业通信数据，导致运行中断、安全隐患及生产停机风险。

Industrial Control.reason: Advantech EKI-1242EIMS edgserver service contains an unauthenticated OS command injection vulnerability, granting full device compromise to network attackers.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Advantech EKI-1242EIMS edgserver service contains an unauthenticated OS command injection vulnerability, granting full device compromise to network attackers.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Advantech EKI-1242EIMS edgserver服务存在无需身份验证的操作系统命令注入漏洞，攻击者利用该漏洞可完全接管设备。

Industrial Control.reason: Advantech web management interface suffers from code injection, allowing authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary Lua scripts on the industrial controller.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Advantech web management interface suffers from code injection, allowing authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary Lua scripts on the industrial controller.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: Advantech Web管理界面存在代码注入漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者在工业控制器上执行任意Lua脚本。

Industrial Control.reason: Authenticated RCE via scripting sandbox bypass exposes industrial monitoring systems to direct command execution.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Authenticated RCE via scripting sandbox bypass exposes industrial monitoring systems to direct command execution.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 通过绕过脚本沙箱实现经身份验证的远程代码执行（RCE），使工业监控系统面临被直接执行命令的风险。

Industrial Control.reason: Malformed RTPS UDP submessage crashes OpenDDS participants, disrupting real-time data distribution in industrial environments.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Malformed RTPS UDP submessage crashes OpenDDS participants, disrupting real-time data distribution in industrial environments.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 格式错误的RTPS UDP子消息会导致OpenDDS参与者崩溃，从而破坏工业环境中的实时数据分发。

Industrial Control.reason: Race condition between memory allocation and data copying in I2C transfer requests can corrupt firmware in automotive and industrial control systems.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Race condition between memory allocation and data copying in I2C transfer requests can corrupt firmware in automotive and industrial control systems.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: I2C传输请求中内存分配与数据复制之间存在竞态条件，可能导致汽车和工业控制系统的固件损坏。

Industrial Control.reason: Transient DoS from insufficient memory validation during large request processing threatens the reliability of edge computing nodes in OT environments.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Transient DoS from insufficient memory validation during large request processing threatens the reliability of edge computing nodes in OT environments.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 在处理大型请求时因内存验证不足导致的瞬时拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，将威胁OT环境中边缘计算节点的可靠性。

Industrial Control.reason: Authentication algorithm flaw in Mitsubishi Electric GX Works3 allows invalid block passwords to bypass security controls, risking unauthorized PLC reprogramming and operational disruption.
Industrial Control.reason_en: Authentication algorithm flaw in Mitsubishi Electric GX Works3 allows invalid block passwords to bypass security controls, risking unauthorized PLC reprogramming and operational disruption.
Industrial Control.reason_zh: 三菱电机GX Works3的身份验证算法存在缺陷，允许使用无效的块密码绕过安全控制，可能导致未经授权的PLC重编程及运行中断。

Web Security.reason: Critical authentication bypass in Picketlink Federation SAML allows unauthenticated attackers to forge assertions and assume any user role, completely undermining web application single sign-on security.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical authentication bypass in Picketlink Federation SAML allows unauthenticated attackers to forge assertions and assume any user role, completely undermining web application single sign-on security.
Web Security.reason_zh: Picketlink Federation SAML存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，允许未认证的攻击者伪造断言并冒充任意用户角色，彻底破坏Web应用的单点登录（SSO）安全性。

Web Security.reason: Forged SSL attributes in Undertow's AJP listener enable unauthenticated client certificate authentication bypass, allowing attackers to impersonate trusted backend services and access protected resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Forged SSL attributes in Undertow's AJP listener enable unauthenticated client certificate authentication bypass, allowing attackers to impersonate trusted backend services and access protected resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Undertow的AJP监听器中存在伪造的SSL属性，可导致客户端证书身份验证被绕过，使攻击者能够冒充受信任的后端服务并访问受保护资源。

Web Security.reason: Resource allocation limits missing in ASP.NET Core allow unauthenticated denial of service attacks, disrupting web application availability and causing cascading failures under sustained traffic.
Web Security.reason_en: Resource allocation limits missing in ASP.NET Core allow unauthenticated denial of service attacks, disrupting web application availability and causing cascading failures under sustained traffic.
Web Security.reason_zh: ASP.NET Core缺少资源分配限制，易遭受未经身份验证的拒绝服务（DoS）攻击，破坏Web应用可用性并在持续流量下引发级联故障。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization controls in Microsoft Office SharePoint enable unauthenticated network code execution, directly exposing enterprise collaboration platforms to remote attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization controls in Microsoft Office SharePoint enable unauthenticated network code execution, directly exposing enterprise collaboration platforms to remote attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint缺失授权控制，允许未经身份验证的网络代码执行，直接使企业协作平台暴露于远程攻击风险中。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint allows attackers to perform spoofing and credential harvesting over the network, compromising user trust and session integrity.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting vulnerability in SharePoint allows attackers to perform spoofing and credential harvesting over the network, compromising user trust and session integrity.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞使攻击者能够在网络上实施欺骗与凭证窃取，损害用户信任与会话完整性。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized network security feature bypass, potentially exposing internal corporate resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery (SSRF) in Visual Studio Code allows unauthorized network security feature bypass, potentially exposing internal corporate resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code存在服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞，允许未经授权地绕过网络安全功能，可能导致内部企业资源泄露。

Web Security.reason: HTTP request/response smuggling in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized security bypass over the network, complicating traffic inspection and WAF evasion.
Web Security.reason_en: HTTP request/response smuggling in Visual Studio Code enables unauthorized security bypass over the network, complicating traffic inspection and WAF evasion.
Web Security.reason_zh: Visual Studio Code存在HTTP请求/响应走私漏洞，可实现未经授权的网络安全绕过，增加流量检测难度并便于WAF绕过。

Web Security.reason: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to execute code over the network, endangering web collaboration and document management platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows authorized attackers to execute code over the network, endangering web collaboration and document management platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint存在访问控制不当问题，允许已认证的攻击者通过网络执行代码，危及Web协作与文档管理平台安全。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates phishing campaigns and credential harvesting against enterprise email users by injecting malicious scripts into web interfaces.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Microsoft Exchange Server facilitates phishing campaigns and credential harvesting against enterprise email users by injecting malicious scripts into web interfaces.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Exchange Server中的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过向Web界面注入恶意脚本，助长针对企业邮件用户的钓鱼攻击与凭证窃取活动。

Web Security.reason: Missing authorization in Exchange Server allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, granting attackers full control over mail infrastructure and sensitive communications.
Web Security.reason_en: Missing authorization in Exchange Server allows unauthenticated privilege escalation, granting attackers full control over mail infrastructure and sensitive communications.
Web Security.reason_zh: Exchange Server缺失授权检查，允许未经身份验证的提权操作，使攻击者获得对邮件基础设施及敏感通信的完全控制权。

Web Security.reason: SQL injection in SharePoint enables unauthorized database access and privilege escalation, exposing sensitive corporate data and collaboration content stored within the platform.
Web Security.reason_en: SQL injection in SharePoint enables unauthorized database access and privilege escalation, exposing sensitive corporate data and collaboration content stored within the platform.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint中的SQL注入漏洞可导致未经授权访问数据库及提权，泄露存储在平台内的敏感企业数据与协作内容。

Web Security.reason: Untrusted pointer dereference in Microsoft Edge enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, targeting end-user browsers.
Web Security.reason_en: Untrusted pointer dereference in Microsoft Edge enables unauthorized privilege escalation over the network, targeting end-user browsers.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中的不受信任指针解引用漏洞可通过网络实现未经授权的提权，主要针对终端用户浏览器。

Web Security.reason: Race condition in Microsoft Edge allows local privilege escalation by exploiting concurrent memory operations in the rendering engine.
Web Security.reason_en: Race condition in Microsoft Edge allows local privilege escalation by exploiting concurrent memory operations in the rendering engine.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Edge中的竞态条件漏洞可利用渲染引擎的并发内存操作实现本地提权。

Web Security.reason: Server-side request forgery in Skype for Business enables information disclosure over the network, allowing attackers to probe internal web resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Server-side request forgery in Skype for Business enables information disclosure over the network, allowing attackers to probe internal web resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Skype for Business中的服务端请求伪造（SSRF）漏洞可导致网络层面的信息泄露，使攻击者能够探测内部Web资源。

Web Security.reason: Critical type confusion flaw in Edge Chromium enabling remote code execution via crafted web content.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical type confusion flaw in Edge Chromium enabling remote code execution via crafted web content.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge Chromium存在关键类型混淆漏洞，攻击者可通过构造的Web内容触发远程代码执行（RCE）。

Web Security.reason: Integer overflow in Edge allows remote attackers to execute code by manipulating memory allocation during page rendering.
Web Security.reason_en: Integer overflow in Edge allows remote attackers to execute code by manipulating memory allocation during page rendering.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge中的整数溢出漏洞允许远程攻击者在页面渲染期间操纵内存分配以执行代码。

Web Security.reason: Deserialization vulnerability in Edge enables remote code execution when processing malicious serialized data.
Web Security.reason_en: Deserialization vulnerability in Edge enables remote code execution when processing malicious serialized data.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge中的反序列化漏洞在处理恶意序列化数据时可导致远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Path traversal issue in Edge allows remote attackers to execute code by controlling file paths during navigation.
Web Security.reason_en: Path traversal issue in Edge allows remote attackers to execute code by controlling file paths during navigation.
Web Security.reason_zh: Edge中的路径遍历漏洞允许远程攻击者在导航过程中通过控制文件路径来执行代码。

Web Security.reason: Microsoft Office SharePoint cross-site scripting allows network-based spoofing by injecting malicious scripts into dynamically generated web pages.
Web Security.reason_en: Microsoft Office SharePoint cross-site scripting allows network-based spoofing by injecting malicious scripts into dynamically generated web pages.
Web Security.reason_zh: Microsoft Office SharePoint的跨站脚本（XSS）漏洞可通过向动态生成的Web页面注入恶意脚本，实现基于网络的欺骗攻击。

Web Security.reason: SharePoint input neutralization failure enables authenticated network spoofing attacks via crafted web requests.
Web Security.reason_en: SharePoint input neutralization failure enables authenticated network spoofing attacks via crafted web requests.
Web Security.reason_zh: SharePoint的输入净化失效漏洞允许攻击者通过构造的Web请求实施已认证的网络欺骗攻击。

Web Security.reason: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in .NET allows network-based security feature evasion. This undermines framework integrity checks and could facilitate malicious payload delivery.
Web Security.reason_en: Cryptographic signature verification bypass in .NET allows network-based security feature evasion. This undermines framework integrity checks and could facilitate malicious payload delivery.
Web Security.reason_zh: .NET中的加密签名验证绕过漏洞可实现基于网络的防御规避。该漏洞破坏了框架完整性校验机制，可能被用于投递恶意载荷。

Web Security.reason: Authorization flaw in Chromium-based Edge enables network-based security bypass. Attackers could circumvent browser protections to execute malicious scripts or access restricted resources.
Web Security.reason_en: Authorization flaw in Chromium-based Edge enables network-based security bypass. Attackers could circumvent browser protections to execute malicious scripts or access restricted resources.
Web Security.reason_zh: Chromium 内核版 Edge 中的授权缺陷可导致基于网络的安全绕过。攻击者可规避浏览器防护机制，从而执行恶意脚本或访问受限资源。

Web Security.reason: Cross-site scripting in Power BI allows network-based spoofing attacks. Compromised dashboards could inject malicious content to deceive enterprise users and exfiltrate session tokens.
Web Security.reason_en: Cross-site scripting in Power BI allows network-based spoofing attacks. Compromised dashboards could inject malicious content to deceive enterprise users and exfiltrate session tokens.
Web Security.reason_zh: Power BI 中的跨站脚本漏洞可导致基于网络的欺骗攻击。遭入侵的仪表板可注入恶意内容以欺骗企业用户，并窃取会话令牌。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe URL interpolation in Prebid Server bidder adapters enables remote code execution via crafted bid requests. Ad tech supply chains are frequently targeted for cryptomining or data theft.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe URL interpolation in Prebid Server bidder adapters enables remote code execution via crafted bid requests. Ad tech supply chains are frequently targeted for cryptomining or data theft.
Web Security.reason_zh: Prebid Server 竞价适配器中存在不安全的 URL 插值漏洞，可通过构造的竞价请求实现远程代码执行。广告技术供应链常因加密货币挖矿或数据窃取而成为攻击目标。

Web Security.reason: Command injection in Copilot Chat (Microsoft Edge) allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Browser-integrated AI tools represent a novel and high-value attack surface for endpoint compromise.
Web Security.reason_en: Command injection in Copilot Chat (Microsoft Edge) allows unauthenticated remote code execution. Browser-integrated AI tools represent a novel and high-value attack surface for endpoint compromise.
Web Security.reason_zh: Copilot Chat (Microsoft Edge) 中的命令注入漏洞可导致无需身份验证的远程代码执行。集成于浏览器的 AI 工具已成为终端失陷的新型高价值攻击面。

Web Security.reason: Authentication bypass via cookie spoofing in Ash Authentication enables session hijacking without valid credentials. Attackers can impersonate legitimate users to access protected application functions.
Web Security.reason_en: Authentication bypass via cookie spoofing in Ash Authentication enables session hijacking without valid credentials. Attackers can impersonate legitimate users to access protected application functions.
Web Security.reason_zh: Ash Authentication 中通过 Cookie 伪造实现的认证绕过可导致无需有效凭据的会话劫持。攻击者可冒充合法用户，从而访问受保护的应用程序功能。

Web Security.reason: Incomplete allowlist validation in WeGIA controller dispatching permits remote code execution. Poor input sanitization in PHP web applications remains a critical risk vector for backend takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: Incomplete allowlist validation in WeGIA controller dispatching permits remote code execution. Poor input sanitization in PHP web applications remains a critical risk vector for backend takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: WeGIA 控制器分发中存在不完整的白名单验证漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。PHP Web 应用程序中输入过滤不严仍是导致后端被控的高危风险途径。

Web Security.reason: Arbitrary file write in Vvveb CMS theme editor allows remote code execution. Attackers can plant malicious scripts to achieve persistent access to the web server.
Web Security.reason_en: Arbitrary file write in Vvveb CMS theme editor allows remote code execution. Attackers can plant malicious scripts to achieve persistent access to the web server.
Web Security.reason_zh: Vvveb CMS 主题编辑器中存在任意文件写入漏洞，可导致远程代码执行。攻击者可植入恶意脚本，从而实现对 Web 服务器的持久化访问。

Web Security.reason: Chamilo LMS allows unauthenticated remote code execution due to unsanitized input handling, directly compromising learning management system deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Chamilo LMS allows unauthenticated remote code execution due to unsanitized input handling, directly compromising learning management system deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Chamilo LMS 因输入处理未进行过滤，可导致无需身份验证的远程代码执行，直接致使学习管理系统部署失陷。

Web Security.reason: vm2 sandbox escape exposes host process modules to sandboxed code, enabling full host takeover when integrated into web application runtimes.
Web Security.reason_en: vm2 sandbox escape exposes host process modules to sandboxed code, enabling full host takeover when integrated into web application runtimes.
Web Security.reason_zh: vm2 沙箱逃逸漏洞会将主机进程模块暴露给沙箱内代码，若集成至 Web 应用运行环境中，可导致主机被完全接管。

Web Security.reason: ToolJet fails to validate organization boundaries, allowing cross-tenant data exfiltration and modification across multi-tenant low-code development platforms.
Web Security.reason_en: ToolJet fails to validate organization boundaries, allowing cross-tenant data exfiltration and modification across multi-tenant low-code development platforms.
Web Security.reason_zh: ToolJet 未能正确验证组织边界，导致在多租户低代码开发平台上发生跨租户的数据外泄与篡改。

Web Security.reason: Trust subnet validation bypass in IPv4-mapped IPv6 notation allows attackers to spoof client IP addresses behind reverse proxies.
Web Security.reason_en: Trust subnet validation bypass in IPv4-mapped IPv6 notation allows attackers to spoof client IP addresses behind reverse proxies.
Web Security.reason_zh: IPv4 映射 IPv6 表示法中的信任子网验证绕过漏洞，可使攻击者伪造反向代理后端的客户端 IP 地址。

Web Security.reason: URI path validation bypass allows unauthenticated access to administrative controllers, compromising jump box management.
Web Security.reason_en: URI path validation bypass allows unauthenticated access to administrative controllers, compromising jump box management.
Web Security.reason_zh: URI 路径验证绕过漏洞可导致无需身份验证的管理控制器访问，致使跳板机管理失陷。

Web Security.reason: JWT algorithm confusion in Apple sign-in verification allows authentication bypass using weak or mismatched cryptographic algorithms.
Web Security.reason_en: JWT algorithm confusion in Apple sign-in verification allows authentication bypass using weak or mismatched cryptographic algorithms.
Web Security.reason_zh: Apple 登录验证中的 JWT 算法混淆漏洞，允许攻击者利用弱或不匹配的加密算法绕过身份认证。

Web Security.reason: Lack of organization membership checks exposes cross-tenant table schemas and row data to any authenticated user.
Web Security.reason_en: Lack of organization membership checks exposes cross-tenant table schemas and row data to any authenticated user.
Web Security.reason_zh: 未校验组织成员关系，导致跨租户的表结构与行数据向所有已认证用户暴露。

Web Security.reason: Server reads attacker-controlled X-GitLab-API-URL headers to redirect outbound API calls, enabling SSRF attacks against internal GitLab instances.
Web Security.reason_en: Server reads attacker-controlled X-GitLab-API-URL headers to redirect outbound API calls, enabling SSRF attacks against internal GitLab instances.
Web Security.reason_zh: 服务器会读取攻击者可控的 X-GitLab-API-URL 请求头并重定向出站 API 调用，从而导致针对内部 GitLab 实例的 SSRF 攻击。

Web Security.reason: Exposure of the host TLS module to vm2 sandboxed code allows attackers to replace system-wide certificate authorities, facilitating widespread MITM attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: Exposure of the host TLS module to vm2 sandboxed code allows attackers to replace system-wide certificate authorities, facilitating widespread MITM attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: 主机 TLS 模块被暴露给 vm2 沙箱代码，攻击者可借此替换系统级证书颁发机构(CA)，从而实施大规模中间人(MITM)攻击。

Web Security.reason: Sandboxed code accesses Node's shared Buffer pool, leading to host memory disclosure and potential data exfiltration from running applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Sandboxed code accesses Node's shared Buffer pool, leading to host memory disclosure and potential data exfiltration from running applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: 沙箱代码可访问 Node.js 的共享 Buffer 池，导致主机内存信息泄露，并可能从运行中的应用中提取敏感数据。

Web Security.reason: User-controlled dataType and unit parameters in CakePHP's FunctionsBuilder are directly concatenated into SQL queries, enabling straightforward injection attacks.
Web Security.reason_en: User-controlled dataType and unit parameters in CakePHP's FunctionsBuilder are directly concatenated into SQL queries, enabling straightforward injection attacks.
Web Security.reason_zh: CakePHP 的 FunctionsBuilder 中用户可控的 dataType 和 unit 参数会被直接拼接至 SQL 查询语句中，导致极易利用的注入攻击。

Web Security.reason: External authentication service attaches new credentials to existing customer accounts based solely on email addresses, enabling trivial account takeover.
Web Security.reason_en: External authentication service attaches new credentials to existing customer accounts based solely on email addresses, enabling trivial account takeover.
Web Security.reason_zh: 外部认证服务仅凭电子邮件地址即可将新凭据绑定至现有客户账户，导致账户可被轻易劫持。

Web Security.reason: Incomplete fix for template injection leaves Craft CMS vulnerable to cross-site scripting, allowing authenticated attackers to manipulate user sessions.
Web Security.reason_en: Incomplete fix for template injection leaves Craft CMS vulnerable to cross-site scripting, allowing authenticated attackers to manipulate user sessions.
Web Security.reason_zh: 针对模板注入漏洞的修复不完整，致使 Craft CMS 仍存在跨站脚本(XSS)漏洞，允许已认证的攻击者操纵用户会话。

Web Security.reason: WebSocket authorization bypass circumvents standard Django security controls, granting unauthorized access to reactive server-side rendering endpoints.
Web Security.reason_en: WebSocket authorization bypass circumvents standard Django security controls, granting unauthorized access to reactive server-side rendering endpoints.
Web Security.reason_zh: WebSocket 授权绕过漏洞绕过了标准的 Django 安全控制机制，导致攻击者可未授权访问响应式服务端渲染端点。

Web Security.reason: Session hijacking flaw in concurrent SAML/OIDC authentication flows compromises single sign-on implementations across modern web applications.
Web Security.reason_en: Session hijacking flaw in concurrent SAML/OIDC authentication flows compromises single sign-on implementations across modern web applications.
Web Security.reason_zh: 并发 SAML/OIDC 认证流程中存在会话劫持漏洞，危及现代 Web 应用中单点登录(SSO)机制的安全性。

Web Security.reason: DOM-based XSS in Vendure dashboard table cells exposes admin interfaces to client-side attacks via administrator-controlled markup injection.
Web Security.reason_en: DOM-based XSS in Vendure dashboard table cells exposes admin interfaces to client-side attacks via administrator-controlled markup injection.
Web Security.reason_zh: Vendure 仪表板表格单元格中存在基于 DOM 的跨站脚本(DOM-XSS)漏洞，攻击者可通过注入可控标记使管理界面暴露于客户端攻击之下。

Web Security.reason: vm2 NodeVM fails to isolate console streams, allowing sandboxed JavaScript to overwrite EventEmitter prototypes and achieve full host process code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: vm2 NodeVM fails to isolate console streams, allowing sandboxed JavaScript to overwrite EventEmitter prototypes and achieve full host process code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: vm2 NodeVM 未能正确隔离控制台流，导致沙箱内的 JavaScript 代码可覆盖 EventEmitter 原型，从而实现主机进程的完全代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Inadequate restriction of os and dns builtins in vm2 permits attackers to hijack host DNS resolution and extract process identity information from the parent environment.
Web Security.reason_en: Inadequate restriction of os and dns builtins in vm2 permits attackers to hijack host DNS resolution and extract process identity information from the parent environment.
Web Security.reason_zh: vm2 对 os 和 dns 内置模块的限制不足，攻击者可借此劫持主机 DNS 解析，并从父进程环境中提取进程身份信息。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Migratico Lite allows immediate server compromise without requiring valid credentials or prior user interaction.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated remote code execution in Migratico Lite allows immediate server compromise without requiring valid credentials or prior user interaction.
Web Security.reason_zh: Migratico Lite 中存在无需身份验证的远程代码执行漏洞，可在无需有效凭据或触发用户交互的情况下直接导致服务器失陷。

Web Security.reason: Privilege escalation in the WordPress Consulting theme exploits an insecure AJAX endpoint, enabling lower-privileged users to manipulate transients and gain administrative control.
Web Security.reason_en: Privilege escalation in the WordPress Consulting theme exploits an insecure AJAX endpoint, enabling lower-privileged users to manipulate transients and gain administrative control.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress Consulting 主题中存在权限提升漏洞，攻击者可利用不安全的 AJAX 端点操纵 Transient 缓存，从而获取管理员权限。

Web Security.reason: Critical unauthenticated/low-priv vulnerability in Oracle BI Enterprise Edition Platform Security allows complete system compromise over HTTP, impacting enterprise analytics deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Critical unauthenticated/low-priv vulnerability in Oracle BI Enterprise Edition Platform Security allows complete system compromise over HTTP, impacting enterprise analytics deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Oracle BI Enterprise Edition Platform Security 中存在关键性的无需认证/低权限漏洞，攻击者可通过 HTTP 协议完全控制系统，严重影响企业数据分析部署。

Web Security.reason: Easily exploitable low-privilege flaw in Oracle Hyperion Financial Management web interface enables unauthorized access and compromise of sensitive financial data processing.
Web Security.reason_en: Easily exploitable low-privilege flaw in Oracle Hyperion Financial Management web interface enables unauthorized access and compromise of sensitive financial data processing.
Web Security.reason_zh: Oracle Hyperion Financial Management Web 界面中存在易于利用的低权限漏洞，可导致未授权访问并致使敏感财务数据处理环节失陷。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated network attacker can exploit the Oracle Commerce Forge component via HTTP, potentially compromising e-commerce platforms and customer data.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated network attacker can exploit the Oracle Commerce Forge component via HTTP, potentially compromising e-commerce platforms and customer data.
Web Security.reason_zh: 无需认证的网络攻击者可通过 HTTP 协议利用 Oracle Commerce Forge 组件，可能导致电商平台及客户数据失陷。

Web Security.reason: Improper HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header validation bypasses authorization mechanisms in gRPC-Go, exposing microservices and APIs to unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_en: Improper HTTP/2 :path pseudo-header validation bypasses authorization mechanisms in gRPC-Go, exposing microservices and APIs to unauthorized access.
Web Security.reason_zh: gRPC-Go 中不正确的 HTTP/2 :path 伪头验证会绕过授权机制，使微服务和 API 面临未授权访问风险。

Web Security.reason: Unauthenticated file upload endpoint in a WordPress plugin lacks authentication and content validation, facilitating rapid malicious script deployment on vulnerable sites.
Web Security.reason_en: Unauthenticated file upload endpoint in a WordPress plugin lacks authentication and content validation, facilitating rapid malicious script deployment on vulnerable sites.
Web Security.reason_zh: WordPress 插件中的未认证文件上传端点缺乏身份验证和内容校验，导致攻击者可在易受攻击的站点快速部署恶意脚本。

Web Security.reason: Insufficient NS record bailiwick validation in Netty enables DNS cache poisoning attacks, compromising traffic routing for applications relying on the framework.
Web Security.reason_en: Insufficient NS record bailiwick validation in Netty enables DNS cache poisoning attacks, compromising traffic routing for applications relying on the framework.
Web Security.reason_zh: Netty 中 NS 记录管辖区域验证不足可导致 DNS 缓存投毒攻击，影响依赖该框架的应用程序的流量路由。

Web Security.reason: Insufficient file type validation during chunked uploads in Gravity Forms Multi Uploader allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute malicious scripts on servers.
Web Security.reason_en: Insufficient file type validation during chunked uploads in Gravity Forms Multi Uploader allows unauthenticated attackers to upload and execute malicious scripts on servers.
Web Security.reason_zh: Gravity Forms Multi Uploader 在分块上传过程中文件类型验证不足，允许未认证攻击者在服务器上上传并执行恶意脚本。

Web Security.reason: Twig sandbox bypass in Grav CMS permits execution of dangerous PHP filters, risking sensitive data leakage or remote code execution in flat-file CMS deployments.
Web Security.reason_en: Twig sandbox bypass in Grav CMS permits execution of dangerous PHP filters, risking sensitive data leakage or remote code execution in flat-file CMS deployments.
Web Security.reason_zh: Grav CMS 中 Twig 沙箱被绕过可执行危险的 PHP 过滤器，在基于文件的 CMS 部署中可能导致敏感数据泄露或远程代码执行。

Web Security.reason: Unsafe PHP unserialize() usage in TYPO3 SOLR indexer creates a high-risk deserialization vulnerability that can be leveraged for remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_en: Unsafe PHP unserialize() usage in TYPO3 SOLR indexer creates a high-risk deserialization vulnerability that can be leveraged for remote code execution.
Web Security.reason_zh: TYPO3 SOLR 索引器中不安全的 PHP unserialize() 使用会导致高风险的反序列化漏洞，可被利用以实现远程代码执行。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Null-termination validation failure in Redis cluster bus packets enables out-of-bounds reads, potentially leaking sensitive memory data and destabilizing distributed database node communications.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Null-termination validation failure in Redis cluster bus packets enables out-of-bounds reads, potentially leaking sensitive memory data and destabilizing distributed database node communications.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Redis 集群总线数据包中空终止符验证失败可导致越界读取，可能泄露敏感内存数据并破坏分布式数据库节点通信的稳定性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Default-permissive deserialization configuration in Red Hat EAP's Artemis messaging allows remote code execution via crafted object messages without proper class filtering or allow-list enforcement.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Default-permissive deserialization configuration in Red Hat EAP's Artemis messaging allows remote code execution via crafted object messages without proper class filtering or allow-list enforcement.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Red Hat EAP 的 Artemis 消息组件默认宽松的反序列化配置允许通过构造的对象消息实现远程代码执行，且未正确实施类过滤或白名单限制。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly threatening enterprise database infrastructure, query processing, and data integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap-based buffer overflow in Microsoft SQL Server enables remote code execution over the network, directly threatening enterprise database infrastructure, query processing, and data integrity.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的堆缓冲区溢出漏洞可通过网络实现远程代码执行，直接威胁企业数据库基础设施、查询处理及数据完整性。

Databases & Middleware.reason: SQL injection flaw in Microsoft SQL Server permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network, risking complete database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: SQL injection flaw in Microsoft SQL Server permits authorized attackers to escalate privileges over the network, risking complete database compromise and sensitive data exfiltration.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: Microsoft SQL Server 中的 SQL 注入漏洞允许已认证攻击者通过网络提升权限，可能导致数据库完全沦陷及敏感数据外泄。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows remote code execution, exploiting a classic attack vector that frequently leads to full system takeover without additional vectors.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server allows remote code execution, exploiting a classic attack vector that frequently leads to full system takeover without additional vectors.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 对不可信数据进行反序列化可导致远程代码执行，该经典攻击向量通常无需其他辅助手段即可实现系统完全接管。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server permits unauthorized network RCE, directly compromising database servers and sensitive stored information.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Deserialization of untrusted data in SQL Server permits unauthorized network RCE, directly compromising database servers and sensitive stored information.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL Server 中的不可信数据反序列化漏洞允许未经授权的远程网络代码执行，直接危及数据库服务器及存储的敏感信息。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables unauthorized network RCE, affecting secure database connectivity and security policy enforcement mechanisms.
Databases & Middleware.reason_en: Heap overflow in the WDAC OLE DB provider for SQL enables unauthorized network RCE, affecting secure database connectivity and security policy enforcement mechanisms.
Databases & Middleware.reason_zh: SQL 的 WDAC OLE DB 提供程序中的堆溢出漏洞可导致未经授权的远程网络代码执行，影响安全数据库连接及安全策略执行机制。

Databases & Middleware.reason: Heap-based buffer overflow in SQL Server permits unauthorized network code execution, severely compromising database integrity and confidentiality.
